name: Quote Card Carousel
description: Dark testimonial slider: an outline badge, bold heading and sub above a peek carousel of folder-notch quote cards. Each card is an SVG silhouette with a raised top-left tab holding the quote glyph, then the quote, an avatar monogram, name, and an accent role. Fully-visible cards brighten while peeking neighbours dim; a ghost prev and a brand next control move through.
interactions: centered carousel: the active card slides to the middle of the viewport (translateX from its offset) while neighbours peek on both sides; prev/next move the active index, clamped to the ends (controls disable there); re-centers on resize
only the centered (active) card is highlighted: opacity .4 -> 1, fill 6% -> 10%, quote from muted -> primary; all others stay dimmed
header items + track fade up on first view (IntersectionObserver, 600ms wpmn-qcc-up, 70ms stagger)
next control uses the brand button fill + glow with hover state; ghost prev hover fill; focus-visible ring
prefers-reduced-motion: track/card transitions off, reveals render in place
